question: GPT-4o 的官方 API 定价（截至 2024-2025）为 Input: $2.50/M tokens, Output: $10.00/M tokens；Claude 3.5 Sonnet 为 Input: $3.00/M tokens, Output: $15.00/M tokens。这些价格构成云端方案的基准成本单位。

sources.title: Pricing | OpenAI API
sources.snippet: For gpt-4o-mini and gpt-4.1-mini with the non-preview web search tool, search content tokens are billed as a fixed block of 8,000 input tokens per call. File search tool call pricing applies to the Responses API only. Container pricing includes Hosted Shell and Code Interpreter.
